subject: Post-call: audit-log schema, DPA redlines, and penetration test path for VaultBank
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lin <sara.lin@vaultbank.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Aug 2027 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: audit-log schema, DPA redlines, and penetration test path for VaultBank

Hi Sara — thanks again for the conversation earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single place to track: 

Summary of pain points you called out
- Audit logs: need schema (field-level), retention windows, and confirmed ability to export logs for auditors.
- Data residency & DPA redlines: procurement needs a version that shows EU/US options and CLARITY on subprocessors.
- Penetration test: VaultBank requires a vendor-facing scope and timeline; you want Redwood to provide a point of contact and proposed scoping worksheet.
- SOC 2 evidence: you want the list of artifacts we can share (and timing for any in-flight audits).

Business goals discussed
- Go-live for internal pilot (limited traffic) in Q4 with audit/controls in place.
- Procurement needs legal redlines completed before pilot starts.

Concrete next steps (what I’m proposing)
1) DPA: I attached our DPA-template-v0.9.docx. I’ll open a DocuSign envelope with the base agreement and highlight the residency options. Request: procurement to flag non-starter clauses in 48 hours.
2) Audit log schema: David (cc) to share the log-schema CSV and retention options by mon/tue next week.
3) SOC 2 artifacts: Monica to share the baseline list of artifacts we can provide and an estimated delivery window for audited evidence.
4) Pen test scope: I attached a proposed pen_test_scope-proposed.xlsx — please confirm whether VaultBank prefers vendor-managed testing or to run through your third-party vendor. We should agree scope and timing within 10 business days.
5) Follow-up: propose a 30-minute sync Tue 2027-08-24 10:00 AM PT to finalize DPA path and confirm evidence intake flow. If that works, I’ll send an invite.

Attachments: Redwood-Security-OnePager.pdf (security summary), DPA-template-v0.9.docx, pen_test_scope-proposed.xlsx

Open items for your team
- Is 7 years retention required for logs or a shorter retention is acceptable?
- Any specific form for evidence (CSV, PDF reports, signed attestations) procurement prefers?

Thanks — I’ll coordinate internally and get the artifacts over.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aisha@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

---
Redwood Inference — developer-first inference platform for production LLMs

From: Sara Lin <sara.lin@vaultbank.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.com>
Cc: VaultBank Procurement <procurement@vaultbank.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Aug 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: audit-log schema, DPA redlines, and penetration test path for VaultBank

Thanks Aisha — appreciate the detailed recap. Quick confirmations from our side: 

- Retention: our baseline requirement is 5 years for audit logs, but we need to confirm whether Redwood can provide configurable retention windows (we may ask auditors for 7 years depending on scope).
- Evidence format: procurement prefers a mix of signed PDFs for attestation, CSVs for raw log exports, and consolidated artifact folder for SOC2 evidence.
- Pen test: VaultBank prefers to use our third-party vendor (Cygnus Security) to perform external testing; we need Redwood to accept the vendor’s rules of engagement and provide a contact and staging environment details.
- DPA redlines: legal will propose a set of redlines focused on data residency and subprocessors. We’ll send the redlines to procurement@vaultbank.com and cc you.

Can you confirm: 1) who from Redwood will be our primary security contact for evidence intake, and 2) when you can share the log schema sample? That will determine our internal timeline.

We can do Tue 2027-08-24 10:00 AM PT. Please send a meeting invite.

Sara Lin
Head of Vendor Risk | VaultBank
sara.lin@vaultbank.com

Aisha / team — looping in our owners and proposing an internal plan so we hit the Tue sync with artifacts: 

Action owners (internal)
- Audit logs & schema (CSV): David — I will export a sample schema and a 7-day synthetic export to illustrate fields and retention capabilities. Deliverable: audit_log_schema_sample.csv by Mon 2027-08-23 16:00 PT.
- Evidence inventory (SOC2): Monica — compile the list of shareable evidence and estimated delivery (start with what we can share immediately). Deliverable: evidence_inventory.csv attached.
- Pen test ROE and staging: David & Infra team — create a staging endpoints doc and aceptable test windows; coordinate with Cygnus once VaultBank confirms vendor.
- DPA comments: Karthik — review VaultBank redlines once received and propose acceptable compromise positions.

Risks / open questions
- Some SOC2 artifacts are produced quarterly and may not be in final audited form until the next cycle; we should flag which items are "preliminary" vs "audited".
- Subprocessor list contains a couple of newer vendors; legal may need extra time on those.

Attachments: evidence_inventory.csv (spreadsheet mapping artifact -> owner -> earliest share date)

I’ll iterate on the schema sample and share via Docsend link ahead of Tue’s call.

-David
